title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajeshwari's humiliation deeply hurts Kanmani, prompting her to lash out at Anbu. Later, Anbu admires Kanmani as she peacefully sleeps despite her anger towards him.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Nalini and Ilamathi doubt Kalamma's kindness after Ganthimathi cooks for Paraman. Later, Kaippulla and Vandu advise Paraman to move forward and live happily with Ilamathi.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri defends Abinaya over a billing mistake, but she tells him to stay away. After losing her job, a bitter Abinaya blames Vetri, while Shanmugam comforts her.
